# Nefertiti Therapy – Masaj Brașov / Massage Brașov

> Professional massage studio in Brașov, Romania. Relaxation, therapeutic, sports and pregnancy massage, reflexology, and couples massage with two therapists working at the same time in the same room. Rated 4.7 on Google by 200+ clients. Professional massage only.

- Address: Strada Codrul Cosminului 40, Brașov, Romania
- Phone / bookings: +40 770 692 621 (Romanian and English)
- Hours: every day 09:00–21:00, weekends included
- Payment: cash, Revolut, bank transfer
- Prices: from 200 lei / 60 min; couples massage 200 lei per person (400 lei for two); Deep Relaxing 250 lei / 75 min; 90-minute packages 300 lei
- Gift vouchers available
